title: Task params for oedis.handler.file.copy
description: Configuration for copying files inside the task inbox using the file handler.

requests.description: List of copy instructions. Each item describes which inbox files to match and where they should be copied.

src_dir.description: Inbox-relative source directory to read from. Empty or omitted means ctx.inbox. The resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

dst_dir.description: Inbox-relative destination directory to copy files into. Empty or omitted means ctx.inbox. The resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

include.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to include. Matching is always against the candidate path relative to src_dir. It does not do separate basename matching.

exclude.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. Matching is always against the candidate path relative to src_dir.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir. When false, only files directly under src_dir are considered.

dst_name.description: Optional destination filename override. This is only valid when exactly one source file matches, and it replaces only the final path segment under the preserved relative parent path.
